plan.skontoDays: Within days of the bill date

plan.debitsAccount: The payment runs debit {account}. The minimum balance applies to this account alone.
plan.debitsAccountShared: The payment runs debit {account}. The minimum balance applies to this account together with the payments whose account is unknown (see Assumptions).

conservative.title: Deducted to be safe
conservative.vat_unattributed: VAT that cannot be assigned to an exact period: {amount}, deducted on {date} to be safe.
conservative.vat_input_not_settled: Input VAT not settled ({period}): {amount} deducted on {date} to be safe. Close the VAT period (post the settlement) and the amount drops away.
conservative.vat_return_refused: VAT {period}: TILL cannot compute this return yet. The tax booked, {amount}, is deducted on {date} to be safe.

floorBreach.message: Scheduled payments take your balance {shortfall} below the minimum on {date}. Lower the minimum to {suggested} or accept the late payments.
floorBreach.lowerPromise: At {suggested} every bill is paid by its due date, and one already overdue on the next bank business day.
floorBreach.overdraws: Paying every bill by its due date takes your balance to {balance} on {date}, and no earlier Skonto payment makes up for it. That does not work even with no minimum: the only way is to pay some bills late.
floorBreach.overdrawsBySchedule: The scheduled payments alone, without a single open bill, take your balance to {balance} on {date}. No payment date changes that, not even a later one: it needs more money on the account or other scheduled payments.
floorBreach.overdrawsNotFound: Paying every bill by its due date takes your balance to {balance} on {date}. Within its time budget TILL found no plan without a late payment, even with no minimum; that does not prove there is none.

assumptions.title: Assumptions
assumptions.noHistory: {n} incoming payments ({amount}) from customers with no payment history: assumed on the due date.
assumptions.pooled: {n} incoming payments ({amount}) dated by the usual payment time of all customers.
assumptions.ledger: Balance of {account} per the books, not per the bank: bank lines not yet booked are missing.
assumptions.vat: VAT: tax booked plus the scheduled recurring invoices; other turnover of the running period is missing.
assumptions.lastDay: Bills sit on the last day on which the payment still arrives on time.
assumptions.accountUnknown: {n} payments with no known account are counted on {account} ({kinds}): in {in}, out {out}.

plan.uploadBy: Upload the file by {date} at the latest, or the payment arrives late.

excludedReason.vat_period_not_started: VAT of a period not yet started (recurring invoices only)
excludedReason.vat_unattributed: VAT on the books that cannot be assigned to a period
excludedReason.vat_due_beyond_horizon: VAT of a period due after the forecast window
excludedReason.unsupported: VAT return TILL cannot compute yet (cash accounting)
excludedReason.vat_period_filed_payment_unknown: filed VAT period whose payment TILL cannot see (net tax rate method)

CreditorPayments.title: Creditor payments
CreditorPayments.body: Here you select open vendor bills and generate a payment file your e-banking reads. TILL transfers nothing itself: you download the file and release it at your bank. Only once the bank has executed do you mark the batch as paid here; only then do the bills count as settled.
